basePrompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: ONE paired 2-sprite texture atlas for a Korean Janggi game skin. Input references 1 and 2 are the original BLACK and WHITE Omok stones: preserve their characteristic materials and palette. Input reference 3 is the blank octagonal Janggi body: preserve its low chunky eight-sided silhouette and broad flat readable face. Create exactly TWO blank octagonal Janggi tokens side by side in a 2:1 landscape image, one matching the dark Omok stone on the LEFT and one matching the light Omok stone on the RIGHT. Each token centered in its own square half, equal size and shape, 80% of the cell width, with clear transparent margins. Straight overhead orthographic camera; regular octagon with horizontal top/bottom edges, vertical sides, 45-degree cut corners, narrow chamfer, slightly darker low sidewall visible at bottom. Neutral soft upper-left lighting and self-shading inside bodies only. Completely empty broad faces for Chinese characters to be rendered separately by the game. Fully opaque bodies, genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside. NO letters, Chinese characters, numbers, icons, engravings, ornaments, board, grid, floor, cast/contact/drop shadow, halo, perspective tilt or background. Transparent gap between tokens. This is a functional production sprite atlas, consistent dimensions and registration for both tokens. Skin-specific material:
